page.title: Integrations
page.purpose: State plainly that integration binding is deferred to integration-hub, and create nothing.

priorities.statement: A deferred step reads as a deliberate decision, not as a broken one.
No control on this step implies a connection can be made.

states.description: Integration Hub is unavailable; the step declares the deferral.
A selected scenario declares an integration; it is named as deferred and nothing is bound.

elements.description: Explains that connector and connection models are owned by integration-hub.
Names an integration a selected scenario declares, marked deferred.

claims.statement: The step states that integration setup is deferred and who owns it.
The step offers no control that would create or imply a connection binding.
claims.rationale: A fabricated connection produces state nothing can honour, discovered at the worst possible time.

claims.statement: A declared integration requirement is named as deferred rather than silently dropped.
